_comment: Operational facts shown on the public site. Everything here is a claim about the business, so nothing is invented: a section only renders once it is filled in from the admin. Empty means the site stays silent rather than guessing.

coverage.note: Set enabled to true once the state list is accurate. Statuses: high, active, limited, none. Any state left out is treated as 'none'.

metrics.note: Case-study ribbon. Only publish figures you can evidence. bar is 0..1 and sets the bar length.

liveFeed.note: The delivery feed on the home page. mode 'simulated' shows illustrative, clearly-labelled activity; 'off' hides the panel. It never claims to be live data.
liveFeed.label: Illustrative delivery activity

calculator.note: Defaults for the volume model. It is a model, not a promise, and is labelled as such.
